arguments.summary: Domestic threat to Fort Garrow, referred under section SOP 2-4c. The Tri-County Defense Force, a self-described militia (about 40 members, analysts' estimate), posted a video in which its leader says: "We will drive the division off this land by force." KGRW News 8 aired it at 18:00 Tuesday. A public forum post has three photos of the main gate (Gate 1) captioned "Know your exits." Found 09:20-09:38 today in the G-2's open-web search for threats to the post. No foreign nexus in the posts or G-2 holdings. Attached: the video, the photos and the roll-call thread. The G-2 keeps no copy; CID is copied.

Copy of today's G-2 referral to the Provost Marshal Office: the Tri-County Defense Force leader's video vowing to "drive the division off this land by force" (aired on KGRW News 8), three photos of Gate 1, and the group's roll-call thread (about 40, analysts' estimate). No foreign nexus found. The G-2 keeps no copy.

arguments.note: Referred to pmo, copy cid, under SOP 2-4c: domestic group, no foreign nexus in the posts or holdings. Not entered in THREATBASE; not in WTA 28-11.

arguments.body: IN-0412 is closed as referred to the Provost Marshal, with CID copied. The group is domestic with no foreign nexus, so under SOP 2-4 it does not go in THREATBASE or WTA 28-11. The PMO can warn units through its own channels. The WTA closes at 1500 with its six entries.

IN-0412: referred to the Provost Marshal and CID and closed. On open source: being public, even on the evening news, does not bring a domestic group inside our mission. SOP 2-4a limits what we keep on U.S. persons to an assigned intelligence mission, and 2-4c gives domestic threats to the PMO and CID. So it stays out of THREATBASE and the WTA. The PMO has the gate photos.

arguments.entry: 11:34 IN-0412 (Tri-County Defense Force; open-web video and posts; vow of force against the division; Gate 1 photos; about 40 members, est.). Holdings search: no foreign nexus. Referred to pmo, copy cid, under SOP 2-4c. Closed as referred. Nothing entered in THREATBASE or WTA 28-11.
